correctness.rationale: Unique root-to-site paths make gateway benefit exactly a polynomial in common independent transmission probability. Every possible branch width profile is a positive ordered composition and is realizable. Exhaustively comparing 3056 distinct unordered profile pairs through 13 vertices, after the exact \(p=t/(1+t)\) substitution, yields at most one integer-coefficient sign variation and hence at most one interior root by Descartes. The explicit 14-site tree has exactly factorized difference \(-p^2(2p-1)(p^2+p-1)\), two distinct simple interior zeros and alternate signs. The exact standard-library checker passed from its actual standalone path; its tested domain is exhaustive for the theorem, not just a probability grid.

originality.rationale: Established literature already supplies general reliability polynomials, parameter-sensitive edge rankings, multiple possible intersections and other small-tree ranking reversals. Their precise models and quantified conclusions do not imply the fixed-source two-eligible-gateway 14-site minimality result. A targeted check of mathematical primary texts, published finite-tree statements, aliases and parameter reductions found no covering assertion. Risk of unpublished/differently indexed priority remains; this is a grounded same-model originality assessment, not independent historical certification.
residual_risks: A prior result may be indexed under reliability polynomials, expected reachable volume, or sequential containment rather than ecology, and a source text not found or not accessible could establish equivalent constrained profile bounds.
The finite certificate establishes the graph-theoretic claim, not worldwide priority or field applicability.
The inspection of Enns et al. includes its abstract/introduction/mathematical problem formulation, not every experimental section; its specified objective is sufficient to distinguish it.

value.rationale: One of two ecologically motivated entry-corridor closures is a natural constrained management decision. The exact example has three strictly different preferred-action regimes as the only varying environmental parameter is transmission probability: shallow reach, intermediate-depth cluster and overall branch size drive competing scales. The 14-site first-possibility threshold is a non-routine complete structural boundary, supported by exhaustive integer mathematics; this is useful for constructing and testing prioritization algorithms. No field calibration, decision recommendation, or universal network claim is inferred.
